verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm an official Claude Desktop app, including a Linux apt-repository install. Cowork's computer-use feature lets Claude read and act on your screen, clicking, typing and opening apps. Nothing in the evidence documents OS-level or global keyboard shortcuts, so only part of the story is supported. Missing for 10: documented OS-level/global hotkeys, explicit screen-sharing or screenshot-into-chat support in the desktop app, independent or hands-on corroboration.
